rules:
**1. General conduct**
• Treat all players with respect.
• No toxicity, trolling, racism, griefing, harassment, hate speech or abusive behaviour. Violations may result in an immediate ban.
• Admin decisions are final.

**2. Gameplay**
• No intentional teamkilling or revenge teamkilling. Report incidents instead; revenge TK may lead to action against everyone involved.
• Do not steal teammate gear or vehicles.
• Play the objective and support your team.
• No exploiting bugs, glitches or unintended mechanics.
• Maximum **6 supply crates per base** at any time.

**3. Main Operating Base (MOB)**
• No AI, mortars, HMGs or other defensive weapons within the MOB.
• Stay at least **400 metres from the enemy MOB**.
• No shooting into or out of any MOB.

**4. Vehicles & equipment**
• Respect role-based vehicle access.
• Do not intentionally waste or abandon vehicles.
• Do not intentionally destroy friendly assets.
• Do not take friendly vehicles or equipment without permission.

**5. In-game communication**
• No mic spam or loud noises. Keep combat communications clear.
• Use English in all public in-game communications.
• No promoting or recruiting for other servers.
• When “Clear Comms” is called, stop all non-essential radio traffic immediately.
• On captured or enemy radios, no spam, loud noises or intentional interference with the enemy team's communications. Light, respectful trash talk is allowed; do not take it too far.

**6. Cheating & exploits**
• Zero tolerance for cheats, hacks or exploits.
• No abusing mechanics or using third-party software for an unfair advantage.
• Violators will be permanently banned.

**7. Admin enforcement**
• Follow all admin instructions.
• Punishments may include a warning, kick, temporary ban or permanent ban.

**8. Common sense**
• Do not ruin the experience for others.
• If it is unfair, abusive or against the spirit of the game, do not do it.

These rules apply to conduct in-game.
